messages.text:
*`Here's the status update Jaan emailed me and Dion at the end of last week` (obvi you already know these points Hrusi haha) :*

I’m on the TNM GCP platform. No problems to report. I’ve got code running on Vertex AI pulling and processing Tiktok data from GCP. For fun I’ve normalised the embedded JSON data which holds the response data from the article posting. I’ve currently got 777 columns of data to look at. That sounds a lot but the way JSON works each column represents a bar (row) of a distribution, so what would take traditionally 1 column now takes 200. We can look at the data in a pivot so it’s not really an issue. With this data I’m able to run some very basic stats analysis, I’ll grow this analysis next week.

We’ve had a call with Hrusi and Guillermo and I’ve been given permission to connect to the live data sources. So, assuming my code scales to the volumes in the live system we should have some real insight to start looking at next week. Simon been brought up to speed on the data pipe issues and has started looking into why TNM and TheRecount Instagram connections are different.
